breakdown.description: With 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa, the longitudinal modulus cannot fall below both constituent moduli.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect statement that the longitudinal modulus is reported as 2.5 GPa, which is exactly the inconsistency that should have been removed. The ground truth omits this erroneous value and only asks to determine the correct E_L from given constituent properties.
